contents.Text: This is the name of the song you are editing.
This is the condition being applied. In this case, adding [[[strong:"Lyrics here lol"]]] to the [[[strong:lyrics]]] column.
[[[strong:Save changes]]] will not perform the above edit once it is removed.
A single song can have more than one condition. In this case, the same song has two conditions:
[[[strong:Add]]] fills in a value for the column, and [[[strong:Replace]]] swaps the existing value for a new one.

[[[warning:Note:]]] The file is only changed when these are actually saved. Each file is read once, all of its conditions are applied, and it is written back to disk once, which saves a lot of performance no matter how many conditions there are.
